product.name: Linen washcloth, pair
product.description: Give it half a day at a wash house, and batch cedar drawer thirty two stays with a flat mailer.

blocks.text: You will find linen cloths and not much else, packed Friday as batch tin stall fifty eight.
The crew at the cutting table uses a cold rinse for this, and this one is batch harbor crate seventy one.
Hand hemming on Friday is how a hemmer on the day shift still finishes these, batch hemp crock forty five.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

trick.evidence_text: You will see Mesh pouch in the bag for six dollars and seven cents.
trick.instruction: Take Mesh pouch out of the bag before you pay. The dialog is offering to keep it.
